description: Revert to the aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) configuration with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as historical data confirms this setup achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, whereas the conservative LR (0.08) used in the current best run (0.9800) likely under-utilized the time by converging too slowly.
